original_catalog.agent_visibility: Complete raw materials, answers and references may be selected for an Environment; the developer controls their use.
original_catalog.archive_scope: Complete pinned upstream archive, including source, ports, documentation and notices; no external toolchain or runtime libraries.
original_catalog.container_strategy: Prepare the fixed source archive during initialization. Dataset conversion is local and compile-only; native benchmark build runs in dev and target consumes prebuilt runtime materials. No OCI or physical-target qualification is inferred.

corpus_contract.code: Complete upstream C sources, Linux/POSIX and other ports, documentation and notices.
corpus_contract.inputs: Original runtime seed values and automatic iteration policy; custom training inputs are separate experiment configuration.
corpus_contract.oracle: Upstream CRC validation is retained for the official Benchmark role; independent semantic qualification is separate.
corpus_contract.split_unit: Ordinary complete-driver program record; the researcher selects the dataset split policy.

original_catalog.purpose: Compact complete C workload usable as an ordinary training program or independently through the original CoreMark measurement protocol.
qualification_gaps: The source archive and native local protocol probe are verified; complete container installation and admitted SSH runtime adapter are not qualified.
A shared-host native result does not establish isolated target performance or industrial compiler correctness.
Source files carry Apache-2.0 notices; LICENSE.md separately contains the CoreMark trademark acceptable-use agreement. No certification or trademark qualification is claimed.
Compile-only Dataset conversion supplies no independent execution oracle. Ordinary training use is allowed by the API; experiment roles and source visibility are researcher-declared.
The official measurement profile requires both standard seed runs, original CRC checks and at least ten measured seconds per run. PGO requires separately reviewed upstream profile seeds.
original_catalog.size_basis: Actual acquired archive byte count and SHA-256; source_logical_bytes sums all 108 ordinary archive files, excluding filesystem block allocation and external dependencies.
original_catalog.title: CoreMark research material

runtime_requirement: Installed compiler-playground 0.21.x library; unchanged DownloadCache, unpack_archive, pack and verify_package APIs
